calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the second clause uses the wrong template. The task sentence 'If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box' is an if-must sentence with no 'also', 'too', 'as well', and no 'before or after', so it is Response(at_exit, holding_box), not RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box). The word 'also' in the normalized clause is not in the task. RespondedExistence accepts a box held earlier and dropped before the exit: after holding_box, dropping the box and walking to the exit empty-handed leaves the machine in u1 with zero reward, while an agent that never held the box pays -1 for the same exit. Replace RespondedExistence with a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box), which requires the box in hand on the exit step itself. Keep the hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), which matches 'pick it up again on your very next move'. Add no Existence clause: the task has only conditionals, so the rule-only warning is valid.
